title: 第15章 误伤第16章 穆家小姐
slug: 凡人修仙开局看守草药场
content_zh:
“公子，这是一千两白银！”
阿红两手空空，身后跟着一个小厮，有些吃力的拎着一个大布袋。
看着小厮将大布袋放在自己面前，苏星河有些哭笑不得，只想着用银子方便，却是忘了一千两是个庞大到，需要用麻袋来装。
市面上流通的白银重量是一比十六，也就是说一斤等于十六两，这千两白银就是六十二斤还多，也难怪需要小厮来送。
“公子需要用多少，可以先取出，剩下的可以给公子换成银票，只是银票只在我们乌骓国通用，出了国，就无效了！”
阁老将炼气丹小心翼翼的装入一个崭新瓷瓶，将瓶口仔细封好，凑近鼻子反复闻了又闻，确认没有丝毫药香溢出，这才收入怀中。
“不用了！”苏星河接过布袋，掂了掂，十分满意。
小厮告退一退出二楼，阁老和阿红盯着苏星河，好奇他怎么处置这一袋银子，难不成就这么拎着招摇过市。
看着二人好奇的目光，苏星河微微一笑，手一翻，千两白银瞬间消失不见，无影无踪。
“啊！”阿红没忍住惊叫出声，连忙伸手捂住嘴。
阁老稍一怔，却是瞬间明白过来。
“少爷！原来是身负储物法器！”
“正是！我看楼下有衣衫售卖，帮我挑两件！”
苏星河身着宗门修炼服，行走在镇上，十分惹眼，还是换成寻常服饰稳妥。
“阿红，快带公子去挑选，所有衣服都免费！望公子以后多照顾小店生意！”
阁老亲自送苏星河下楼，最后示意自己楼上还有客人，与苏星河拱手致礼，这才匆匆返回。
苏星河随便挑了两件单色锦袍，低调有内涵，那种秀云纹，刺金线的袍子，看上去就惹眼，像极了纨绔，苏星河不喜。
离开珍宝阁，阿红立在门前不停的挥手告别，直至苏星河身影消失不见。
“阿红！他当真出售了一枚炼气丹？”先前吵吵着要找阁老投诉的美艳女子，试着问道。
“没有，公子只挑了两件袍子！”说罢，扭着纤腰，朝店里另外一名挑选袍子的客人迎过去。

“骗鬼呢！我去找阁老！”美艳女子冷哼一声，直奔二楼。
阿红转头看了一眼楼梯口，一脸的讥讽。
苏星河离开珍宝阁后，直奔马市。
汉子见苏星河赶回，连忙迎上，搓着手，急切道：“公子这锦袍都换上了，看来是兑换妥当了？”
“这是二十两，你拿好！”苏星河手一翻，递过两个元宝，十两一个，正好二十两。
“公子爽快，这马归你了！”汉子解开缰绳，递给苏星河。
苏星河，脚下一点，轻飘飘的跨上马背，脚下一夹，骏马直接冲入人群。
虽然不曾学过骑马，但有修为在身，很快适应，再加上骏马训练有素，跑起来更是稳当，整个街道，就见一个少年，鲜衣怒马，春风得意，引来无数人侧目
“这是谁家公子，真是一表人才！”
“翩翩佳公子！不知可否娶妻，我要将小女嫁给他！”
“老东西，你那女儿长的像夜叉，也好意思拿出来显摆！”
“你放屁！我女儿貌美如花，与这位公子那是绝配！”
content_en:
"Sir, this is one thousand taels of silver!"
Ah Hong's hands were empty, and a boy followed behind him, carrying a big cloth bag with some difficulty.
Seeing the boy put the big bag in front of him, Su Xinghe was a little bit dumbfounded. He only thought about the convenience of using the silver, but he forgot that one thousand taels was so huge that it needed to be packed in a sack.
The weight of silver circulating in the market is one to sixteen, which means that one pound is equal to sixteen taels. This thousand taels of silver is more than sixty-two pounds. No wonder a servant is needed to deliver it.
"You can take out as much as you need, and the rest can be exchanged for silver notes. However, the silver notes are only valid in our country of Wuzhui. They will be invalid outside the country!"
The veteran Ge carefully put the Qi Refining Pill into a brand new porcelain bottle, carefully sealed the mouth of the bottle, brought it close to his nose and smelled it repeatedly to make sure that there was no trace of medicinal fragrance leaking out, and then he put it in his arms.
"No need!" Su Xinghe took the bag, weighed it, and was very satisfied.
After the boy excused himself and exited the second floor, Mr. Ge and A Hong stared at Su Xinghe, wondering what he would do with the bag of money, and whether he could carry it across the market like this.
Looking at the curious eyes of the two, Su Xinghe smiled slightly, flipped his hand, and the thousand taels of silver disappeared without a trace in an instant.
"Ah!" Ah Hong couldn't help but screamed, and quickly covered her mouth with her hand.
Mr. Ge was startled for a moment, but he understood instantly.
"Master! It turns out that he is carrying a storage magic weapon!"
"Exactly! I saw there are clothes for sale downstairs, help me pick out two pieces!"
Su Xinghe was wearing sect training clothes and was very eye-catching when walking in the town, so it was safer to change into ordinary clothes.
"Ah Hong, take the young master to pick out the clothes quickly. All clothes are free! I hope the young master will take care of the shop business in the future!"
Mr. Ge personally escorted Su Xinghe downstairs. Finally, he signaled that there were guests upstairs, bowed his hands with Su Xinghe, and then hurried back.
Su Xinghe randomly picked two single-color brocade robes, which were low-key and connotative. The robes with beautiful cloud patterns and embroidered gold threads looked eye-catching and looked like a dandy. Su Xinghe didn't like it.
After leaving the Zhenbao Pavilion, A Hong stood in front of the door and kept waving goodbye until Su Xinghe disappeared.
"A Hong! Did he really sell a Qi Refining Pill?" The beautiful woman who had been clamoring to complain to Mr. Ge tried to ask.
"No, the young master only picked two robes!" After saying that, he twisted his slender waist and walked towards another customer who was choosing robes in the store.
"You're a liar! I'll go find Mr. Ge!" The beautiful woman snorted coldly and went straight to the second floor.
A Hong turned her head and glanced at the stairs, with a sarcastic look on her face.
After Su Xinghe left Zhenbao Pavilion, he went straight to the horse market.
Seeing Su Xinghe rushing back, the man hurriedly greeted him, rubbed his hands, and said anxiously: "Young Master has put on this brocade robe. It seems that the exchange has been completed?"
"Here are twenty taels, take it!" Su Xinghe turned over his hand and handed over two ingots, one with eleven taels, exactly twenty taels.
"Young Master, please be happy, this horse belongs to you!" The man untied the reins and handed it to Su Xinghe.
Su Xinghe stepped on the horse's back lightly, and with a pinch of his feet, the horse rushed directly into the crowd.
Although I have never learned to ride a horse, I have the skills to adapt to it quickly. In addition, the horse is well-trained and can run even more steadily. In the whole street, I saw a young man wearing bright clothes and angry horses. He was proud of the spring breeze and attracted countless people's attention.
"Whose young master is this? He is truly a talented person!"
"Young Master Pianpian! I don't know if I can get a wife. I want to marry my little daughter to him!"
"Old man, your daughter looks like a Yaksha, but you have the nerve to show it off!"
"You fart! My daughter is as beautiful as a flower, and she is a perfect match for this young master!"
